title: API Knowledge Observation
description: A timestamped observation about an API — a single retrieval event that contributes evidence to a knowledge record. Multiple observations over time produce a history that lets consumers detect change.

recordId.description: ID of the knowledge record this observation belongs to.

fields.description: Field-level snapshot of what was observed (e.g. baseURL, version, rateLimit) at observation time.

delta.description: Optional diff against the previous observation.
